questions.question: Soccer 12, skipping 8, chatting 7, reading 5. Write two sentences that summarise this data.
questions.expected_answer: Soccer was the most popular break-time activity, chosen by 12 of the 32 learners, and reading was the least popular, with 5. A quarter of the class, 8 learners, skips at break.

questions.question: The shoe sizes of 20 learners include eight size 4s, five size 5s, four size 3s, two size 6s and one size 2. Find the mode and explain.
questions.expected_answer: The mode is size 4, because it appears 8 times, more often than any other size.

questions.question: Can the class conclude that all children in South Africa prefer soccer at break? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: No. The data comes from only 32 learners in one Grade 5 class, so it describes that class. Other grades, schools and seasons could give different results.
